meaning_block.formal_definition: Existence and distinction are co-primitive: neither is derivable from the other, and each is a necessary condition for the articulation of the other.
meaning_block.mathematical_form: ¬(∃x ∧ ¬∃D) ∧ ¬(∃D ∧ ¬∃x), where D is a distinction operator on a domain; Domain ≠ ∅ ⟺ Distinction ≠ ∅
meaning_block.common_sense_meaning: There is no 'something' without 'not-something', and no difference that exists in total vacuum. Being and difference arrive together — you cannot state one without already using the other.

governing_questions.question_answered: Which comes first: being or difference? (Answer: the question is malformed — they co-arise.)
governing_questions.problem_solved: Prevents a regress of priority between existence (A1.1) and distinction (A1.2); blocks both monism-without-content and pluralism-without-ground.
governing_questions.kill_condition: If a coherent semantics can state existence with zero distinction structure (or distinction with zero domain), the co-arising claim collapses and A1.1/A1.2 revert to competing primitives.
governing_questions.downstream_license: Licenses the typed relation grammar: because being and difference co-arise, typed relations R(x,y) over a non-empty domain are well-formed without further primitive.
governing_questions.unresolved: Does co-arising itself require a ground (a Source), or is co-arising the terminal explanation? This axiom cannot answer its own grounding question.

meaning_block.why_it_matters: Every later axiom predicates something of something. If being/difference priority were unsettled, the entire typed grammar of the atlas would rest on an unresolved fork.

nabla.breadcrumb: Global > Axiomatic Core > Root > A1.0 Co-Arising

claim.statement: Existence and distinction are co-primitive; neither is prior to the other.
claim.scope: Meta-axiomatic: governs the grammar of every downstream axiom.

evidence.summary: Any statement of existence (∃x) already deploys the x / not-x distinction; any deployment of distinction presupposes a domain of items distinguishable.

warrant.proof_test: Attempt to formalize ∃x with no partition structure, or D with empty domain; show each attempt smuggles in the other primitive (regress test).
counterevidence: Structuralist accounts (category-theoretic ontology) sometimes claim objects are fully determined by relational distinction alone, weakening the existence side of the pairing.
kill_conditions: A semantics is exhibited in which existence is expressible with zero distinction structure, or vice versa.
assumptions: Classical bivalent articulation is admissible for the statement of the axiom itself.

dynamics.coherence: Coherent if every downstream axiom's statement can be parsed as typed predication over a non-empty domain.
dynamics.degradation: Degrades if downstream nodes must silently choose a priority (existence-first or distinction-first) to be stated.
dynamics.measurement: Count downstream axioms whose statements parse without a priority fork.
dynamics.threshold: Degradation declared if >5% of downstream axioms require an unstated priority assumption.
dynamics.asymmetry: Asymmetric in consequence: violating it affects grammar globally, not locally.

restoration.self: None — this is a primitive layer; it cannot be restored from within.
restoration.external: Revision at the root: re-seat A1.1/A1.2 as independent primitives and retire A1.0.

dynamics.counterexample: None known within the system; open in rival ontologies.

ascent: Why is there something rather than nothing, and why is that something structured rather than undifferentiated?

forbidden: Deriving existence from logic alone (idealism) or distinction from pure chaos alone (materialism)

bridges.ablation: Remove distinction operator: all downstream typed relations become ill-formed.

reality_mirror.provenance: Root layer of the 191-axiom production set; position 0/191.
reality_mirror.closed_loop_warning: Yes — the axiom is stated using the very grammar it licenses; treat self-application as definitional, not evidentiary.

meaning_block.formal_definition: Something exists rather than nothing: the domain of discourse is non-empty. ∃x (x = x).
meaning_block.mathematical_form: ∃x : x ∈ D, with D ≠ ∅; in Lean 4: Nonempty D as a typed instance at the root of the derivation tree.
meaning_block.common_sense_meaning: There is not nothing. Before any law, equation, or argument can be true of anything, there has to be a 'something' for it to be true of. Existence is the floor under every other claim.

governing_questions.question_answered: Why is there something rather than nothing?
governing_questions.problem_solved: Closes the zero-domain regress: without a non-empty domain, no predication, measurement, or relation can be stated at all.
governing_questions.kill_condition: If the system can be coherently formalized over an empty domain (free logic without existential import at the root), A1.1 fails as a primitive and demotes to a convention.
governing_questions.downstream_license: Licenses every existential claim in the atlas: A1.2 (distinction needs items to distinguish), the relation grammar, and all anchor classes N/F/H/T (each asserts something exists to anchor).
governing_questions.unresolved: Existence is asserted, not derived. The further question — why existence is ordered, intelligible, or sourced rather than brute — is NOT answered here and is deferred to the derivation series.

meaning_block.why_it_matters: This is position 1 of 191: one of four irreducible primitives. Every atom, bridge, and receipt in the Consilience Atlas silently assumes a non-empty domain; A1.1 makes that assumption explicit and auditable.

nabla.breadcrumb: Global > Axiomatic Core > Root > A1.1 Existence

claim.scope: The domain of discourse is non-empty.

evidence.summary: Any act of analysis (including denial) exhibits an existing analyzer and an existing denial — the cost of denying the axiom is performing it.
All observation is of something; no instrument registers an empty universe.

warrant.proof_test: Performative-consistency test: formalize the denial of ∃x and check whether the denial's own tokens exist as marks in the formal system.
counterevidence: Substructural and free-logic frameworks can be developed over empty domains; they are coherent but produce no applied mathematics and no physics.
kill_conditions: A working applied science (predictive, measurement-connected) is exhibited on a genuinely empty-domain foundation.
assumptions: The law of identity x = x is admissible at the root.

dynamics.coherence: Coherent as long as every downstream existential is traceable to the root non-emptiness.
dynamics.degradation: Degrades silently when downstream nodes introduce existentials with no source (phantom entities).
dynamics.measurement: Audit downstream packets for unlicensed existential imports.
dynamics.threshold: Any unlicensed existential in an admitted atom triggers review.
dynamics.asymmetry: Asymmetric: existence cannot be 'un-asserted' locally; failure is global.

restoration.self: Re-derive the offending downstream node's existential from A1.1.
restoration.external: If the entity resists derivation, retire the downstream node.

dynamics.counterexample: None admitted; the burden of exhibiting an empty-domain applied science has never been met.

ascent: What must be true before any claim can be true at all?

lost: Any claim about the character of what exists
forbidden: Deriving existence from non-existence; treating nothingness as a rival existent

negative_controls: Vacuum states in QFT are not nothing — they retain structure and observables.
bridges.ablation: Remove A1.1: all measurement claims lose their object; the physics rail cannot state that anything was observed.

reality_mirror.anchor_object: Existence of the observable universe (one actual world at minimum)
reality_mirror.provenance: Root layer of the 191-axiom production set; position 1/191.

meaning_block.formal_definition: Things are distinguishable: for items in the domain, identity and difference are well-defined. ∀x∀y (x = y ∨ x ≠ y), with x ≠ y realizable.
meaning_block.mathematical_form: D(x, y) ∈ {0, 1} (distinction function) with ∃x∃y : D(x, y) = 1; in Lean 4: DecidableEq D as a typed instance over the root domain.
meaning_block.common_sense_meaning: A thing is itself and not another thing. If nothing could be told apart, there would be no information, no language, no '2+2', no science — one undifferentiated blob. Distinction is what makes content possible.

governing_questions.question_answered: How can one thing be different from another — and why is there more than one thing to talk about?
governing_questions.problem_solved: Closes the monism regress: without realizable difference, the domain guaranteed by A1.1 contains exactly one indistinguishable item and no predication can discriminate anything.
governing_questions.kill_condition: If a coherent information-bearing system is exhibited in which nothing is ever distinguishable (no partitions, no decidable equality, zero channel capacity), A1.2 collapses.
governing_questions.downstream_license: Licenses identity and difference throughout the atlas: taxonomy, classification, the 15 markers (each marker is a distinction), measurement (which requires discriminated outcomes), and all bridge directionality (source vs. target).
governing_questions.unresolved: Distinction guarantees difference but not its kind, degree, or stability. Continua, vagueness boundaries, and the identity of composite objects over time are downstream burdens this axiom does not carry.

meaning_block.why_it_matters: Every classification act in the atlas — every grade, register, marker, and rail — is a distinction. A1.2 is the license for the entire taxonomy layer.

nabla.breadcrumb: Global > Axiomatic Core > Root > A1.2 Distinction

claim.statement: Distinction is realizable in the domain: identity and difference are well-defined.
claim.scope: Decidable identity over the non-empty domain licensed by A1.1.

warrant.claim: ∃x∃y : D(x, y) = 1 over the root domain.

evidence.summary: Any statement — including this one — distinguishes itself from its negation; distinction is performed by every mark in every formal system.
Measurement outcomes are discriminable; information channels have non-zero capacity; physical states are addressable (position, momentum, charge eigenbases).

warrant.proof_test: Channel-capacity test: attempt to transmit one bit through a system in which no distinction is realizable; show the capacity is identically zero and therefore no science (which transmits results) can run on it.
counterevidence: Quantum contexts where properties are not jointly decidable; vagueness at continuum boundaries; these bound the axiom's scope but do not eliminate decidable distinction — they presuppose it to state the problem.
kill_conditions: A working measurement-bearing science is exhibited with identically zero discriminable structure.
assumptions: A1.1 (non-empty domain) — you cannot distinguish within nothing.

dynamics.coherence: Coherent as long as every classification in the atlas applies decidable criteria.
dynamics.degradation: Degrades when classification boundaries become unprincipled (distinction without criterion).
dynamics.measurement: Audit marker definitions m01–m15 for decidable application rules.
dynamics.threshold: Any marker whose application requires an unstated judgment call triggers review.
dynamics.asymmetry: Symmetric in form (x≠y iff y≠x) but asymmetric in consequence at bridges: source and target domains lose/gain differently.

restoration.self: Sharpen the criterion for the failing distinction.
restoration.external: If no criterion exists, collapse the distinction and merge the classes.

dynamics.counterexample: None admitted; quantum non-joint-decidability restricts simultaneous distinctions, not distinction itself.

ascent: How can there be information, language, or number unless things can be told apart?

forbidden: Equivocation (treating distincts as identical without a bridge)

negative_controls: Perfectly symmetric states with zero accessible information — distinguished from 'no distinction' by the system's own addressability.
bridges.ablation: Remove A1.2: channel capacity is identically zero; no measurement result can be communicated; the information rail is void.

reality_mirror.anchor_object: Discriminable physical states (addressable degrees of freedom)
reality_mirror.provenance: Root layer of the 191-axiom production set; position 2/191.
